title: Glucosamine Linked to Faster Alzheimer's Progression
seoTitle: Glucosamine and Alzheimer: Study Shows Risks
subtitle: Research finds link between joint supplement and higher chance of progression to dementia.
excerpt: A health‑record analysis shows glucosamine use is tied to a faster Alzheimer's progression, with a 25% higher chance of mild cognitive impairment advancing to dementia.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A popular joint supplement, glucosamine, has been linked to a faster progression of Alzheimer’s disease, according to a new large‑scale health‑record analysis.

The data revealed that users of the product had a 25% higher probability that mild cognitive impairment would progress to dementia. The investigation highlights the compound’s effects in patients already diagnosed with cognitive changes.

Laboratory experiments suggest the supplement may intensify an abnormal sugar‑marking process in the Alzheimer‑affected brain. However, researchers emphasize that future clinical trials are needed to determine whether the product truly causes the observed damage.

With information from ScienceDaily.
